milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the center of the plains-like grass area with animals (offset ~-3, ~0, ~0 from spawn where passive mobs are). Since the player spawns in the middle of the grass platform, the target is set slightly off-center toward the animal area. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement) ensures the player just needs to be present in the plains area and observe it. This is a find/observe task so position_near_with_facing is preferred over position_inside_box.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the center of the magenta terracotta structure at spawn-relative (9, 1, 9). max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked close enough to clearly see the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure, confirming visual observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the trapped chest at spawn-relative (9, 0, 9) inside the magenta terracotta hut. max_distance=3 ensures the player has entered or is at the doorway of the structure (close enough to clearly see the chest). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the chest, confirming they have found it.
